---
title: Crypt — keyed encounters
---

## C1. Entry Hall {#c1}

> The crypt door grinds open on a draft that smells of cold iron and
> dust. Four pillars hold up a low vault; bones crunch underfoot.

An iron-bound chest stands between the southern pillars. A pressure plate
in front of it fires spears from the floor (save vs. paralysation or 2d6).
The lever that disarms it is behind the north-west pillar.

## C2. Throne Chamber {#c2}

> A hexagonal hall. A circle of runes glows violet on the floor around a
> stone sarcophagus, and a robed figure chants over it.

[[npc:ritualist]] is two rounds from finishing the binding. If the party
dawdles in [C1](text:crypt-key#c1), the ritual completes and the
[[encounter:c2-saint]] rises.

![The ritualist's token](asset:ritualist-token)

## C3. Vestry Alcove {#c3}

A narrow robing room. The ritualist's escape route: a loose flagstone
leads to the hillside. Under the vestments, a purse of 40 gp.
